# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

# Toshiba America | Energy, Industrial, and Electronics Solutions

## About Toshiba AMERICA

### Toshiba specializes in providing comprehensive Energy, Industrial, and Electronics Solutions
### across the Americas.

[ Learn More ][246]

## From Power Generation to Decarbonization: Toshiba Leads the Way

Anchoring the power generation capabilities of our Energy, Industrial, and Electronics Solutions,
Toshiba America Energy Systems (TAES) focuses on advanced power generation and decarbonization. We
provide technical services for installed energy equipment while pioneering carbon-neutral
technologies—including hydrogen, carbon capture, and next-generation geothermal. From thermal and
nuclear to hydro power, TAES is building a reliable path forward.

 

Discover how we’re shaping the energy landscape for a cleaner planet.

[ Learn More ][247]
[Rolling green hills with wind turbines in the background, symbolizing Toshiba's commitment to
sustainable power generation and clean energy solutions.]
[Wind-powered energy-generated windmills on a green hillside.]
[Technician in hard hat and safety vest working on industrial equipment, representing Toshiba's
on-site services for manufacturing and critical infrastructure.]

## Driving Sustainability: Toshiba's Industrial and Infrastructure Innovations

Spearheading the manufacturing and infrastructure side of our Energy, Industrial, and Electronics
Solutions, Toshiba International Corporation (TIC) delivers technologies for a resilient future. We
maximize efficiency with high-performance motors, hybrid vehicle systems, and power electronics like
UPS and solar inverters. From sustainable transportation to water treatment, TIC provides the
innovation and reliability that powers modern industry.

 

Discover how we’re revolutionizing industrial solutions and infrastructure for a better future.

[ Learn More ][248]

## Empowering the Future: Semiconductor & Data Innovations

Defining the technological edge of our Energy, Industrial, and Electronics Solutions, Toshiba
America Electronic Components (TAEC) leads in semiconductors and data storage. Our energy-efficient
power devices—including Si, SiC, and GaN—and high-capacity hard disk drives support a rapidly
developing AI world. From automotive to industrial applications, we deliver the technology driving
modern innovation.

 

Discover how we’re leading the semiconductor revolution for a smarter, more sustainable future.

[ Learn More ][249]
[Close-up of a Toshiba semiconductor chip overlaid on the internal components of a hard drive,
illustrating Toshiba’s advanced semiconductors and data storage solutions.]

# Toshiba America | Energy, Industrial, and Electronics Solutions

## About Toshiba AMERICA

### Toshiba specializes in providing comprehensive Energy, Industrial, and Electronics Solutions
### across the Americas.

[ Learn More ][246]

## From Power Generation to Decarbonization: Toshiba Leads the Way

Anchoring the power generation capabilities of our Energy, Industrial, and Electronics Solutions,
Toshiba America Energy Systems (TAES) focuses on advanced power generation and decarbonization. We
provide technical services for installed energy equipment while pioneering carbon-neutral
technologies—including hydrogen, carbon capture, and next-generation geothermal. From thermal and
nuclear to hydro power, TAES is building a reliable path forward.

 

Discover how we’re shaping the energy landscape for a cleaner planet.

[ Learn More ][247]
[Rolling green hills with wind turbines in the background, symbolizing Toshiba's commitment to
sustainable power generation and clean energy solutions.]
[Wind-powered energy-generated windmills on a green hillside.]
[Technician in hard hat and safety vest working on industrial equipment, representing Toshiba's
on-site services for manufacturing and critical infrastructure.]

## Driving Sustainability: Toshiba's Industrial and Infrastructure Innovations

Spearheading the manufacturing and infrastructure side of our Energy, Industrial, and Electronics
Solutions, Toshiba International Corporation (TIC) delivers technologies for a resilient future. We
maximize efficiency with high-performance motors, hybrid vehicle systems, and power electronics like
UPS and solar inverters. From sustainable transportation to water treatment, TIC provides the
innovation and reliability that powers modern industry.

 

Discover how we’re revolutionizing industrial solutions and infrastructure for a better future.

[ Learn More ][248]

## Empowering the Future: Semiconductor & Data Innovations

Defining the technological edge of our Energy, Industrial, and Electronics Solutions, Toshiba
America Electronic Components (TAEC) leads in semiconductors and data storage. Our energy-efficient
power devices—including Si, SiC, and GaN—and high-capacity hard disk drives support a rapidly
developing AI world. From automotive to industrial applications, we deliver the technology driving
modern innovation.

 

Discover how we’re leading the semiconductor revolution for a smarter, more sustainable future.

[ Learn More ][249]
[Close-up of a Toshiba semiconductor chip overlaid on the internal components of a hard drive,
illustrating Toshiba’s advanced semiconductors and data storage solutions.]

## Who’s Driving Growth with AIReel

Short-form content moves fast, and the creative process should too. AIReel helps turn everyday ideas
into polished images and videos for social posts, campaign launches, paid creative, and ongoing
promotion without the usual production overhead.

Make more of the content your audience already clicks on, from [AI ASMR][31] videos to [AI
Bikini][32] edits and short viral clips. Turn simple ideas into repeatable formats you can post
again and again.

### SNS Influencers

Create trend-driven videos that feel native to your feed, whether it is an [AI Kiss][33] post, a
playful [AI Life4Cuts][34] moment, or a quick reaction-style reel. Keep up with trends without
rebuilding every video from zero.

### Brand Marketers

Turn viral-style video formats into brand-ready creative for social promos, launches, and campaign
content. Across [Seedance 2.0][35], [Kling 3.0][36], [Vidu Q3][37], and more, marketers get sharper
motion, cleaner style outputs, and more reusable assets across channels.

### UGC Ad Makers

Build ad creatives that look less like ads and more like content people actually watch. Use standout
formats such as [AI Spring Portraits][38] to test hooks faster and turn one idea into multiple ad
variations.

### AI Video Beginners

Start with easy formats built around [AI Earth Zoom][39] and [AI Fursona][40], so you can create
polished videos without getting stuck in complex tools. With a simple workflow and familiar content
ideas, even first-time users can make something worth posting.

### Business Owners

Use simple commerce-ready formats to promote products without making traditional marketing videos.
Start with [Image to Video][41] or [Text to Video][42] to turn ideas, product photos, and offers
into short clips that are lighter, faster, and easier to post.

## Who’s Driving Growth with AIReel

Short-form content moves fast, and the creative process should too. AIReel helps turn everyday ideas
into polished images and videos for social posts, campaign launches, paid creative, and ongoing
promotion without the usual production overhead.

Make more of the content your audience already clicks on, from [AI ASMR][31] videos to [AI
Bikini][32] edits and short viral clips. Turn simple ideas into repeatable formats you can post
again and again.

Create trend-driven videos that feel native to your feed, whether it is an [AI Kiss][33] post, a
playful [AI Life4Cuts][34] moment, or a quick reaction-style reel. Keep up with trends without
rebuilding every video from zero.

Turn viral-style video formats into brand-ready creative for social promos, launches, and campaign
content. Across [Seedance 2.0][35], [Kling 3.0][36], [Vidu Q3][37], and more, marketers get sharper

Build ad creatives that look less like ads and more like content people actually watch. Use standout
formats such as [AI Spring Portraits][38] to test hooks faster and turn one idea into multiple ad
variations.

Start with easy formats built around [AI Earth Zoom][39] and [AI Fursona][40], so you can create
polished videos without getting stuck in complex tools. With a simple workflow and familiar content
ideas, even first-time users can make something worth posting.

Start with [Image to Video][41] or [Text to Video][42] to turn ideas, product photos, and offers

[radiology-of-breast-fat-necrosis][29][ Full Page ][30]

During routine lumbar spine MRI screening, a 52-year-old asymptomatic patient is found to have
multiple small cystic lesions along the sacral nerve roots bilaterally, each measuring 3-5mm. On
T1-weighted images, the lesions are hypointense, and on T2-weighted images, they are hyperintense
with signal intensity matching cerebrospinal fluid. What is the most appropriate clinical management
recommendation?
**Options:**1. Immediate surgical decompression to prevent future neurological compromise2.
Conservative management with clinical follow-up, as most perineural cysts are asymptomatic and do
not require intervention3. Urgent CT-guided biopsy to rule out malignancy4. Prophylactic radiation
therapy to prevent cyst enlargement
[perineural-cyst-radiology][31][ Full Page ][32]

**Question:**🔴 Expert
A 35-year-old male with a 5-year history of chronic kidney disease is on hemodialysis three times
weekly. Laboratory studies reveal elevated parathyroid hormone and phosphate levels. Based on the
provided images, what is the most likely diagnosis?
**Options:**1. Renal osteodystrophy with osteosclerosis2. Multiple myeloma with lytic lesions3.
Paget disease of bone4. Osteoporosis secondary to chronic corticosteroid use
[radiology-of-renal-osteodystrophy][13][ Full Page ][14]
**Question:**🔴 Expert
A 25-year-old man with chronic renal failure presents with progressive arthralgia and bone pain.
Bone scintigraphy is performed to evaluate for metabolic bone disease. Based on the provided image,
what is the most likely diagnosis?
**Options:**1. Renal osteodystrophy2. Primary hyperparathyroidism3. Paget disease of bone4.
Metastatic bone disease
[radiology-of-renal-osteodystrophy][15][ Full Page ][16]
**Question:**🔴 Expert
A 67-year-old woman presents with progressive dyspnea and a chronic cough. She has no significant
smoking history. High-resolution CT of the chest is performed. Based on the provided image showing
numerous smooth, thin-walled, round to oval cysts evenly distributed throughout both lungs including
the costophrenic angles, with normal intervening parenchyma and no internal septa or traversing
vessels, what is the most likely diagnosis?
**Options:**1. Lymphangioleiomyomatosis (LAM)2. Pulmonary Langerhans cell histiocytosis3.
Desquamative interstitial pneumonia (DIP)4. Birt-Hogg-Dubé syndrome
[radiology-of-lymphangioleiomyomatosis][17][ Full Page ][18]
**Question:**🔴 Expert
A 68-year-old woman with osteoporotic compression fracture of L4 undergoes vertebroplasty for pain
management. Post-procedure imaging is obtained to assess for complications. Based on the provided
image showing axial CT and T2-weighted sagittal MRI, what is the most likely complication
demonstrated?
**Options:**1. Intraspinal bone cement leakage2. Epidural hematoma from needle tract hemorrhage3.
Retropulsed bone fragment compressing the spinal cord4. Postoperative discitis at the adjacent level
[complications-vertebroplasty-and-kyphoplasty][19][ Full Page ][20]
**Question:**🔴 Expert
A 68-year-old male with a history of radical cystoprostatectomy for bladder cancer 3 years ago
presents with recurrent urinary tract infections and gross hematuria. Imaging workup is initiated.
Based on the provided image showing selective left internal iliac arteriography, what is the most
likely diagnosis?
**Options:**1. Internal iliac arterioureteral fistula2. Ureteral stricture with collateral arterial
supply3. Ureteral pseudoaneurysm with contained rupture4. Ileal conduit leak with arterial erosion
[ureteral-fistula-interventional-radiology][21][ Full Page ][22]
**Question:**🔴 Expert
A 67-year-old woman with a history of asbestos exposure presents with progressive abdominal
distension and pain. CT imaging of the abdomen is performed. Based on the provided image showing
thickened visceral peritoneum completely encasing small bowel loops with a characteristic 'teca'
appearance, along with thickened parietal peritoneum, what is the most likely diagnosis?
**Options:**1. Malignant peritoneal mesothelioma2. Peritoneal carcinomatosis from gastric primary3.
Tuberculous peritonitis4. Peritoneal pseudomyxoma peritonei
[radiology-of-peritoneal-mesothelioma][23][ Full Page ][24]
**Question:**🔴 Expert
A 41-year-old woman presents with newly developed bloody nipple discharge from the left breast.
Imaging is performed including dynamic contrast-enhanced MRI with early and delayed subtractions,
T2-weighted imaging, and diffusion-weighted imaging with ADC mapping. It demonstrated plateau-type
enhancement kinetics (Kaiser score 2). Based on the provided image, what is the most likely
diagnosis?
**Options:**1. Benign intraductal papilloma2. Papillary carcinoma3. Intraductal papillary neoplasm
with high-grade dysplasia4. Ductal carcinoma in situ with papillary features
[radiology-of-breast-papillary-lesions][25][ Full Page ][26]
**Question:**🔴 Expert
A 27-year-old woman, G2P2, presents with postpartum metrorrhagia and markedly elevated serum HCG.
MRI and CT imaging are provided. Based on the provided image, what is the most likely diagnosis?
**Options:**1. Gestational trophoblastic neoplasia (choriocarcinoma)2. Retained products of
conception with secondary infection3. Uterine arteriovenous malformation4. Postpartum uterine
rupture with hematoma
[gestational-trophoblastic-disease-radiology][27][ Full Page ][28]
**Question:**🔴 Expert
A 46-year-old female presents for routine mammographic screening. She has a history of left total
breast reconstruction with autologous fat transfer performed 2 years and 10 months ago. Based on the
provided image showing MLO and CC views of the left breast, what is the most likely diagnosis?
**Options:**1. Fat necrosis with oil cysts2. Invasive ductal carcinoma with microcalcifications3.
Fibroadenoma with coarse calcifications4. Phyllodes tumor with dystrophic calcifications
[radiology-of-breast-fat-necrosis][29][ Full Page ][30]
**Question:**🟡 Intermediate
During routine lumbar spine MRI screening, a 52-year-old asymptomatic patient is found to have
multiple small cystic lesions along the sacral nerve roots bilaterally, each measuring 3-5mm. On
T1-weighted images, the lesions are hypointense, and on T2-weighted images, they are hyperintense
with signal intensity matching cerebrospinal fluid. What is the most appropriate clinical management
recommendation?
**Options:**1. Immediate surgical decompression to prevent future neurological compromise2.
Conservative management with clinical follow-up, as most perineural cysts are asymptomatic and do
not require intervention3. Urgent CT-guided biopsy to rule out malignancy4. Prophylactic radiation
therapy to prevent cyst enlargement
[perineural-cyst-radiology][31][ Full Page ][32]

## Radiation Protection Products

Barrier Technologies® is America’s leading manufacturer of **radiation protection products**. We are
committed to continual innovation and serving the medical industry by producing superior **radiation
shielding products** using high quality of **radiation shielding **materials.

## Our Radiation Protection Products

We control the quality of our products by manufacturing everything in-house. From metal fabrication
to fabric manufacturing and product assembly, all our **x ray** radiation products are created
within our facilities.

Our industry-leading products include lightweight lead-free aprons, [velcro-free thyroid
collars][29], protective gloves, leaded eye protection, [mobile lead shields][30], and many more
radiation safety products.

## Innovation in Radiation Protection Technology

Barrier Technologies’ tenacious drive to innovate is one of the qualities that sets us apart from
other radiation shield manufacturers. From leadership to engineering, every tier of our company is
motivated to develop new solutions to problems within our sphere of the medical industry.

### Ultraflex™ and MagnaGuard™ Technology Products

Two powerful examples of our commitment to innovation are our Ultraflex™ and MagnaGuard™ proprietary
products:
* **Ultraflex™** is an outer material for our aprons, vests, and mobile shields. Unlike traditional
  nylon, which is porous and can’t be washed, we engineered Ultraflex™ to be an antibacterial and
  stain-free fabric — helping medical personnel maintain a sterile environment.
* **MagnaGuard™** is a patented magnetic closure we developed to eliminate the use of velcro on
  aprons and thyroid guards. Studies have shown velcro to be a transmitter of dangerous bacteria and
  disease. MagnaGuard™ mitigates these risks.

Our innovative products are also inspired by our customers. For example, our breakthrough Terminator
XR™ mobile lead shields were developed after a local doctor asked us to create an alternative to
cumbersome hanging lead shields.

If you are dissatisfied with your current **radiation protection products**, contact our team and
inquire about our customization services.

**radiation shielding**. Our catalog includes everything necessary to build a robust, easy-to-clean
radiation protection suit:

needs of your medical organization. Don’t have time to wait for a custom order? Then order from our
Ready To Go line of aprons — a selection of Ultraflex™ and MagnaGuard™ equipped aprons that ship
within 24 hours of your order.

## Anti-bacterial

The anti-bacterial surface of the UltraFlex apron helps in providing the hygienic condition so
necessary during all procedures. Additives on the surface material help reduce potential cross
contamination.

[[lightweight feather icon | X Ray Lead Aprons]][47]

## Lightweight

The unique composition of the radio protective inner core material significantly reduces the weight
of the UltraFlex apron. This provides maximum comfort compared to leaded and other non-leaded
aprons.

[[stain resistant white icon | Lead Aprons]][48]

## Stain Resistant

Stain and Fluid resistance of the urethane surface of the UltraFlex apron makes clean up and apron
maintenance easier and more effective while maintaining that spotless appearance expected for
procedures.

[[flexible white icon | X Ray Lead Aprons]][49]

## Flexible

UltraFlex outer fabric has 4 way stretchability. The inner apron lining is a softer more adaptable
and breathable fabric. The combination of these two components provides the renowned flexibility of
the UltraFlex apron.

# Compassionate Patient Care

For more than 60 years, Hastings Radiology has been associated with quality, professionalism, and
compassion.

# Professional & Focused

We are always changing and adapting to new imaging technology, but our core values will never
change.

# Expert Imaging Interpretation

At Hastings Radiology, we provide the highest level of medical imaging services to central Nebraska
and north central Kansas using leading-edge technology and the highest level of imaging expertise.

### Hastings Radiology Associates, PC

At Hastings Radiology, we provide the highest level of medical imaging services to central Nebraska
and north central Kansas using leading-edge technology and the highest level of imaging expertise.
Our reputation for clinical excellence is the result of our scope of services, our prompt turnaround
time, the knowledge and skill of our affiliated hospitals and clinics, and compassionate care for
patients. For more than 60 years, Hastings Radiology has been associated with quality,
professionalism, and compassion. We are always changing and adapting to new imaging technology, but
our core values will never change.


#### Our Mission

Provide imaging interpretation and expertise; collaborate with other healthcare providers and
entities in a professional manner; and focus on patients with care and compassion.

#### Our Vision

Maintain expertise on all and upcoming imaging technologies; focus on prompt service to patients and
healthcare providers; and provide radiation safety and protection.

#### Nuclear Medicine

Includes bone scans, PET scans, cardiac stress tests, kidney scans, ventilation and perfusion scans,
and gastric emptying exams.

**[Learn More][54]**

#### Interventional Radiology

Includes pain management, image guided biopsy, abscess drainage, throacentesis, paracentesis, IVC
filter placement, nephrostomy tubes, ureter stents, lumbar punctures, and myelograms.

**[Learn More][55]**

#### Bone Density

Bone Densitometry (dual-energy-x-ray-absorptiometry or DEXA) is considered to be "The Gold Standard"
for diagnosing osteoporosis or bone loss.

**[Learn More][56]**

#### MRI

Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is one of the safest, most comfortable imaging techniques
available. MRI uses a magnetic field instead of radiation to obtain images of the body.

**[Learn More][57]**

#### Breast Biopsy

Current estimates say that one in eight women will experience breast cancer during their lifetime.
Mammography is the best test available for finding small breast cancers.

**[Learn More][58]**

#### Digital Mammography

Mammography is a specific type of imaging that uses a low-dose x-ray system for examination of the
breasts. Most medical experts agree that successful treatment of breast cancer is linked to early
diagnosis.

**[Learn More][59]**

#### Teleradiology

Hastings Radiology Associates has a long history of service to hospitals, clinics, and imaging
centers via remote teleradiology.

**[Learn More][60]**

#### Breast Tomosynthesis

Breast tomosynthesis, also called three-dimensional (3-D) mammography and digital breast
tomosynthesis (DBT), is an advanced form of breast imaging where multiple images of the breast from
different angles are captured and reconstructed ("synthesized") into a three-dimensional image set.

**[Learn More][61]**

#### Women’s Imaging

Hastings Radiology Associates features the most comprehensive dedicated Women's Imaging center in
the region.

**[Learn More][62]**

#### Digital X-Ray

An x-ray is the oldest and most commonly used form of medical testing.

and north central Kansas using leading-edge technology and the highest level of imaging expertise.

### Hastings Radiology Associates, PC

At Hastings Radiology, we provide the highest level of medical imaging services to central Nebraska
and north central Kansas using leading-edge technology and the highest level of imaging expertise.
Our reputation for clinical excellence is the result of our scope of services, our prompt turnaround
time, the knowledge and skill of our affiliated hospitals and clinics, and compassionate care for
patients. For more than 60 years, Hastings Radiology has been associated with quality,
professionalism, and compassion. We are always changing and adapting to new imaging technology, but
our core values will never change.


#### Our Mission

Provide imaging interpretation and expertise; collaborate with other healthcare providers and
entities in a professional manner; and focus on patients with care and compassion.

#### Our Vision

Maintain expertise on all and upcoming imaging technologies; focus on prompt service to patients and
healthcare providers; and provide radiation safety and protection.

#### Nuclear Medicine

Includes bone scans, PET scans, cardiac stress tests, kidney scans, ventilation and perfusion scans,
and gastric emptying exams.

**[Learn More][54]**

#### Interventional Radiology

Includes pain management, image guided biopsy, abscess drainage, throacentesis, paracentesis, IVC
filter placement, nephrostomy tubes, ureter stents, lumbar punctures, and myelograms.

**[Learn More][55]**

#### Bone Density

Bone Densitometry (dual-energy-x-ray-absorptiometry or DEXA) is considered to be "The Gold Standard"
for diagnosing osteoporosis or bone loss.

**[Learn More][56]**

#### MRI

Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is one of the safest, most comfortable imaging techniques
available. MRI uses a magnetic field instead of radiation to obtain images of the body.

**[Learn More][57]**

#### Breast Biopsy

Current estimates say that one in eight women will experience breast cancer during their lifetime.
Mammography is the best test available for finding small breast cancers.

**[Learn More][58]**

#### Digital Mammography

Mammography is a specific type of imaging that uses a low-dose x-ray system for examination of the
breasts. Most medical experts agree that successful treatment of breast cancer is linked to early
diagnosis.

**[Learn More][59]**

#### Teleradiology

Hastings Radiology Associates has a long history of service to hospitals, clinics, and imaging
centers via remote teleradiology.

**[Learn More][60]**

#### Breast Tomosynthesis

Breast tomosynthesis, also called three-dimensional (3-D) mammography and digital breast
tomosynthesis (DBT), is an advanced form of breast imaging where multiple images of the breast from
different angles are captured and reconstructed ("synthesized") into a three-dimensional image set.

**[Learn More][61]**

#### Women’s Imaging

Hastings Radiology Associates features the most comprehensive dedicated Women's Imaging center in
the region.

**[Learn More][62]**

#### Digital X-Ray

An x-ray is the oldest and most commonly used form of medical testing. It is a painless and quick
test for the patient to endure.

**[Learn More][63]**

#### Ultrasound

Ultrasound is a non-invasive imaging modality based on transmitting ultra-high frequency sound waves
into the body and then receiving the returning echoes.

**[Learn More][64]**

#### CT

Computed Tomography (CT) is a diagnostic imaging procedure that combines the use of x-rays with
computer technology to produce cross-sectional images (“slices”) of the body. The images produced
are more detailed than those of an ordinary x-ray.

**[Learn More][65]**

## Why Choose Hoag

#### At Hoag, we combine clinical excellence with compassionate, personalized care—earning top
#### rankings for quality, safety and outcomes.

Patients choose Hoag because we deliver more than expertise. We offer access to advanced treatments,
cutting-edge technology, and a robust portfolio of clinical trials, all within a system built around
your needs. From routine checkups to the most complex diagnoses, Hoag is committed to advancing
care, improving lives, and being the health partner you trust.

[Learn more about Hoag][97]
[Dr Chang Hoag Desk]
[Pause][Chevron left small icon][Chevron right small icon]

## We’re part of your community

Thanks to a generous commitment from philanthropists Diana and David Sun, and the continuing support
of community donors, Hoag is expanding its hospital campus in Irvine, fulfilling South Orange
County’s need for access to comprehensive, world-class care.

Easily accessible to patients throughout Orange County and beyond, the campus will bring together
comprehensive services including cancer care, digestive health, women’s health, imaging, and
outpatient procedures all within one integrated location.

## Why Choose Hoag

#### At Hoag, we combine clinical excellence with compassionate, personalized care—earning top
#### rankings for quality, safety and outcomes.

cutting-edge technology, and a robust portfolio of clinical trials, all within a system built around
your needs. From routine checkups to the most complex diagnoses, Hoag is committed to advancing
care, improving lives, and being the health partner you trust.

County’s need for access to comprehensive, world-class care.

Easily accessible to patients throughout Orange County and beyond, the campus will bring together
comprehensive services including cancer care, digestive health, women’s health, imaging, and
outpatient procedures all within one integrated location.

## When you need answers

At I-MED Radiology, we can eliminate guesswork and help you and your doctor to clear answers. Our
comprehensive range of services, coupled with specialist opinions and accessible imaging,
consistently delivers improved health outcomes for our patients. 

[
Learn moreLearn more
][49]

## Integrating your radiology journey seamlessly

1

## Book an appointment

Self-manage your radiology appointment with I-MED's online booking system. Simply select your
preferred clinic, date, and time. It’s convenient and saves time waiting on the phone. Available for
most scans.

[Book an Appointment][50]
2

## Manage your appointment

Do you need to reschedule? Our convenient self-service portal allows you to easily reschedule or
cancel your appointment, in just a few clicks.

[Manage appointments][51]
3

## View your images

View, download and share your images on your phone. Access your images via an SMS link sent after
your scan is received by your referring practitioner. View your report via this link 7 days after
your referrer receives it. 

[Find out more][52]
4

## Speak with your doctor

When our radiologist has finalised your results, I-MED will send a report directly to your referring
practitioner. It is important to speak with your health practitioner about your results, to
understand what they mean and complete follow-up treatment.

5

## Find out about e-Referrals

We offer healthcare practitioners a streamlined system to make e-Referrals as a first step in the
digital health journey, designed to enhance accessibility for our patients.

[Find out more][53]
[Caring staff member with patient having CT scan]

## Our clinics offer a range of medical procedures

I-MED Radiology clinics offer a range of imaging procedures including MRI, CT scans, x-ray,
ultrasound and nuclear medicine. With the largest team of sub-specialist radiologists, practitioners
and patients can be assured of the highest quality imaging and diagnosis.

[
Find a radiology clinicFind a radiology clinic
][54]
[A female patient in a surgical gown prepares for an MRI at I-MED Radiology ]

Easily access procedure-specific instructions, to be fully prepared for your appointment. Some scans
don’t require any preparation at all such as x-ray and some CT scans, however many scanning
procedures do and you will receive preparation instructions from our clinics when you book your
procedure online. 

[

2

## Manage your appointment

Do you need to reschedule? Our convenient self-service portal allows you to easily reschedule or
cancel your appointment, in just a few clicks.

View, download and share your images on your phone. Access your images via an SMS link sent after
your scan is received by your referring practitioner. View your report via this link 7 days after

practitioner. It is important to speak with your health practitioner about your results, to

## Thank you for building PharmiWeb.com

Since 1998, this community has helped people find opportunities, build careers, and connect across
the industry. As we close this chapter, we do so with gratitude and pride in what we created
together.

For everyone who found an opportunity here, from *entry-level roles* to *VP positions*, and
everything in between.

And for every advertiser, partner, reader, and every member of the PharmiWeb team since 1998.

We were there at the beginning of the dot-com era, even beating Google to the start line.

But times have changed, and we have made the tough decision to close PharmiWeb.

We’re proud you were part of this journey

## [About Planmeca Group][330]

Planmeca Oy is the parent company of Planmeca Group, which operates in the field of healthcare
technology and consists of several companies. Planmeca Group companies manufacture and supply
state-of-the-art dental care equipment and instruments, dental and medical imaging devices and
software, as well as mammography systems. Planmeca Group also includes companies providing dental
supplies, services and education.

technology and consists of several companies. Planmeca Group companies manufacture and supply

## Planmed Clarity™ 3D –
## The most compact system for ultra-sharp DBT and DM images

The Planmed Clarity™ digital mammography and breast tomosynthesis system has been designed to
provide the best possible experience in all situations. The system provides fast and calming exams
for patients, effortless and ergonomic usability for mammographers, and high-quality 2D and 3D
imaging for reliable breast cancer detection.

## **Book an online meeting**

Interested in our products? Why not book an online meeting! It’s a convenient way to get in-depth
info on our products. You will have the opportunity to speak with one of our experts directly and to
ask questions from them.

[BOOK NOW][90]

## Planmed Verity®
## – The original weight-bearing CT

Planmed Verity is a point-of-care extremity CT providing high quality 3D images with a low patient
dose. The design of the unit is driven by design philosophy of Planmed to maximized ergonomics and
experience for patient and user.

## Purview FAQs

What does Purview offer?

Purview provides secure, cloud-based technology that helps organizations access, organize, and share
medical images and records — turning complex clinical information into insight that powers better
decisions.

What’s the difference between Purview Image™ and Expert View™?

[**Purview Image™**][35] focuses on medical image management — upload, view, share, and store DICOM
studies in the cloud.

**[Expert View][36]™** supports full case collaboration, including records, communication,
workflows, and second opinion programs.

Who typically uses Purview?

Purview supports any organization that is looking to access or share medical imaging or entire
patient cases remotely. Purview users are diverse, ranging from specialty provider groups,
hospitals, payer/employer networks, concierge medicine, professional athletes, virtual health
programs, medical legal teams, researchers and veterinarians.

Can I share studies directly from one PACS to another PACS with Purview Image™?
Use the FAQ section of your site to answer those routine questions that always come up and need to
be answered. This is a great way to tell us more about what you can offer, fill in some details that
might intrigue us, and show us how knowledgeable and helpful you can be.
Is Purview secure and HIPAA compliant?

Yes. Purview is built on HIPAA-aligned infrastructure with independently examined SOC 2® controls,
role-based permissions, and encrypted data transfer.

Do users need special software or downloads?

No. Purview's software runs in the browser and works on virtually any device, including desktops,
tablets, and mobile.

Can Purview support remote reads and second opinions?

Absolutely. Purview is designed to help specialists review cases from anywhere, collaborate with
peers, and deliver timely reports.

Does Purview integrate with our existing systems?

Purview is designed to complement your current infrastructure and can integrate with many systems
including EHRs, practice management systems, websites and web forms, PACS environments, and other
clinical workflows.

Can we use both Purview Image and Expert View together?

Yes. Many organizations use Purview Image for imaging logistics and Expert View to manage referrals,
interest in consultations, records reviews and destination health programs.

How do we get started?

The best way to get started is by booking an introductory call or a personalized demo by [filling
out the form here][37]. Our team will learn about your goals and workflow and recommend the right
solution.

## OFFICIAL MEDICAL PROVIDER

RAYUS Radiology servers as an Official Medical Provider to the U.S. Ski and Snowboard, the U.S.
Speedskating and the USA Bobsled and Skeleton Teams nationwide. Our Cutting-edge technology,
industry-leading protocols and best-in-class radiologists leads to replicable, reliable results.

[Learn About Our Athletic Partnerships][68]

[RAYUS Radiology diagnostic imaging center in 5200 Executive Centre Parkway Suite 400, St. Peters,
MO 63376][RAYUS Radiology diagnostic imaging center in 5200 Executive Centre Parkway Suite 400, St.
Peters, MO 63376]

## REFER YOUR PATIENTS

Through the highest quality procedures, images and interpretations – we’ll support your efforts to
deliver the highest level of care and best possible outcomes for your patients.

[Refer Your Patients][69]

## 50 STATES PARTNERSHIP SOLUTIONS

Insight Imaging mobile solutions is now RAYUS Radiology. With short- and long-term partnership
solutions in 50 states and Canada, we bring full-service mobile diagnostic imaging and staffing
solutions to hospitals, clinics, and health care organizations.

[Learn About Partnerships ][70]

## JOIN THE RAYUS NETWORK

RAYUS Radiology has the capital strength, investment experience and operational expertise you need
from a partner. We offer quality radiologists to staff hospital inpatient locations, joint venture
opportunities in all local markets, and employment or partnership options for radiologists.

2009 – 2012 – аспирантура и защита кандидатской  диссертации «Прогнозирование эффективности

акад. И.П. Павлова

2024 – стажировка по реконструкции молочной железы, по микрохирургии и лечении лимфедемы

штат Техас, Хьюстон, MD Anderson Сenter.

I was impressed by the team's knowledge of the complexities of the aerospace segment that helped
make the study focus on specific information that mattered to us. I also was happy with the variety
of industry experts and the depth of the interviews that were completed.

Global Marketing Leader - Aerospace at DuPont

We are truly impressed by the output Stratview Research delivered within such a short span of time.
This was the most thorough analysis of these key and highly niche markets provided by an Outside
Company. The overall findings were very enlightening. Great job by your team.

Commercial Director at Lyodell Basell

The Stratview team is professional, always sticks to their promises, and approaches challenges with
a practical, thoughtful mindset. They’re great at communicating, keeping us in the loop, and
delivering on time, every time. Their attention to detail and ability to tailor their research to
our needs have made them a go-to partner for us.

Vice President & General Manager at Aerovac (CompositesOne)

The market research report that we have purchased has been also very satisfactory. Apparently it has
a very good structure and methodology in discussing the subject that reflects for sure a well
performed effort during the analysis phase.

Marketing Manager - Composites at Olin Corporation

I found the report very informative and very well organized. Stratview did a great job in assembling
the information in a concise and easy to understand format.

VP of Engineering at Triumph Group

Very good customer service & commercial attraction. Report is very insightful with many details and
angles of view. I would definitely recommend Stratview to an industrial company & come back to you
in the future for projects which technical insights are needed

Strategic Procurement at Bombardier

I have appreciated our cooperation with Stratview prior to and during the period of market research
and the follow up calls during and after the presentation of the results. The results of your
research have been of great help to us, enabling us to sharpening our insights in the various market
sectors we are active in.

Senior Manager - Strategic Marketing at MBCC Group

I’d like to thank you Stratview for the good analysis and support for our internal report. The

wouldn’t be possible without including Stratview research data. I thank Stratview for the assistance
and looking forward working with them in the future.

## Catching Errors: Why Independent QA Matters

[Patient Safety Starts Here][59]

*1*
  A single monitor chamber was the source of fluctuating linac outputs. Daily QA^{TM} 3 caught it,
  protecting patients.¹

*~10%*
  A patient's spinal cord was overdosed by ~10%. The precise reason why was caught by SunCHECK^{TM}
  Patient.²

*52*
  A year of weekly trajectory file measurements on 2 linacs found no errors. Concurrent EPID-based
  data caught many.³

*>1 mm*
  “It has been clinically observed the log-file derived leaf positions can differ from their actual
  position by >1 mm.”⁴

**SunCHECK v5.0 and the AVa Phantom are not available for sale in all markets. CE mark pending.* The
AVa Phantom is patent-pending.*



*¹ T. McCaw, et al., When a Good Monitor Chamber Goes Bad: Diagnosing Atmospheric Communication of a
Sealed Monitor Chamber, AAPM 2018
² Sun Nuclear SunCHECK user internal testing
³ A. Agnew et al., Monitoring daily MLC positional errors using trajectory log files and EPID
measurements for IMRT and VMAT Deliveries, Phys. Med. Biol. 59, (2014)
^{4 }B. Neal, et al., A clinically observed discrepancy between image-based and log-based MLC
positions, Med Phys. 43, 2933 (2016)*

Sci-Hub is the most controversial project in today science. The goal of Sci-Hub is to provide **free
and unrestricted** access to all scientific knowledge ever published in journal or book form.

Today the circulation of knowledge in science is restricted by high prices. Many students and
researchers cannot afford academic journals and books that are locked behind paywalls. Sci-Hub
emerged in 2011 to tackle this problem. Since then, the website has revolutionized the way science
is being done.

Sci-Hub is helping millions of students and researchers, medical professionals, journalists and
curious people in all countries to unlock access to knowledge. The mission of Sci-Hub is to fight
every obstacle that prevents open access to knowledge: be it legal, technical or otherwise.

To get more information visit the [about Sci-Hub][56] section.

Sci-Hub is the most controversial project in today science. The goal of Sci-Hub is to provide **free
and unrestricted** access to all scientific knowledge ever published in journal or book form.

Today the circulation of knowledge in science is restricted by high prices. Many students and
researchers cannot afford academic journals and books that are locked behind paywalls. Sci-Hub
emerged in 2011 to tackle this problem. Since then, the website has revolutionized the way science
is being done.

Sci-Hub is helping millions of students and researchers, medical professionals, journalists and
curious people in all countries to unlock access to knowledge. The mission of Sci-Hub is to fight
every obstacle that prevents open access to knowledge: be it legal, technical or otherwise.

To get more information visit the [about Sci-Hub][56] section.

## Where Patients are Partners

The Medical City, one of the premier hospitals in the Philippines, has defined for itself the value
proposition: "Where Patients are Partners." This phrase finds its fullest meaning when the patient
is viewed not as a problem to be solved or a charge to be cared for, but as a partner in his own
health.

[stethoscope icon]

With JCI's Gold Seal of Approval you are guaranteed a world-class healthcare experience at The
Medical City

## Why Choose The Medical City?

The Medical City is not like any other health center in the Philippines. Our world-class hospital
and medical center are the staging areas for the delivery of cutting-edge health care services, with
centers of excellence in wellness and aesthetics, cardiovascular, cancer and regenerative medicine.

## Where Patients are Partners

The Medical City, one of the premier hospitals in the Philippines, has defined for itself the value
proposition: "Where Patients are Partners." This phrase finds its fullest meaning when the patient
is viewed not as a problem to be solved or a charge to be cared for, but as a partner in his own
health.

The Medical City is not like any other health center in the Philippines. Our world-class hospital
and medical center are the staging areas for the delivery of cutting-edge health care services, with
centers of excellence in wellness and aesthetics, cardiovascular, cancer and regenerative medicine.

## Your health, on your time

MyUFHealth is a secure application that lets you manage your health at home and on the go.
* Manage your appointments
* View your test results
* Send messages to your doctor
* Request medication refills
* Pay your bill

## when you need it
* ### Primary Care
  
  Choose from our network of highly skilled doctors and providers for your regular care.

* ### Specialty Care
  
  Our experts are here to treat your unique medical and surgical needs.
  
  [ Find Adult Specialty Care ][33] [ Find Pediatric Specialty Care ][34]

  Visit Urgent Care when you can't wait to be seen by your primary care provider.
  
  [ Find Urgent Care ][35]

  Our ER and trauma centers are available 24/7 for when you need immediate help.
  
  [ Find Emergency Care ][36]

  We offer a complete range of dental and oral health care for adults and children.
  
  [ Find a Dentist ][37]

## Your health, on your time

MyUFHealth is a secure application that lets you manage your health at home and on the go.
* Manage your appointments
* View your test results
* Send messages to your doctor
* Request medication refills
* Pay your bill

[ Sign in or Sign Up ][29] [ What is MyUFHealth? ][30]
[Smart phone with MyUFHealth open in the browser app]

## Get the right care,
## when you need it
* ### Primary Care
  
  Choose from our network of highly skilled doctors and providers for your regular care.
  
  [ Find Adult Primary Care ][31] [ Find Pediatric Primary Care ][32]
* ### Specialty Care
  
  Our experts are here to treat your unique medical and surgical needs.
  
  [ Find Adult Specialty Care ][33] [ Find Pediatric Specialty Care ][34]
* ### Urgent Care
  
  Visit Urgent Care when you can't wait to be seen by your primary care provider.
  
  [ Find Urgent Care ][35]
* ### Emergency Care
  
  Our ER and trauma centers are available 24/7 for when you need immediate help.
  
  [ Find Emergency Care ][36]
* ### Dental Care
  
  We offer a complete range of dental and oral health care for adults and children.
  
  [ Find a Dentist ][37]

We’ve joined the **U.S. Olympic & Paralympic Medical Network**, where we're now providing Team USA's
elite athletes with the same world-class health care that's available to you and your family.

[ Our Collaboration ][38] [ Amazing Athletes ][39]

## Improving health and lives through research

As part of a top-tier research university, we have a passion to explore, discover and innovate.

[ Our Research ][40]

## Training tomorrow's health care providers

Part of the Southeast's largest academic health center, we have an enduring commitment to education.

[ Our Education Programs ][41]

## Join a team moving
## medicine forward

Be part of a team dedicated to excellent patient care and health education.
